name: Skeleton
summary: The shape of content that has not arrived yet. Three placeholder shapes and, if the motion is welcome, a shimmer over them.
summaryZh: 还没到的内容的轮廓。三种占位形状,以及在动效被允许时加在上面的那层微光。

variants.name: Text
variants.note: One line of text, one body height tall.

variants.name: Circle
variants.note: A round placeholder, for an avatar.

variants.name: Block
variants.note: A wider block, for a picture or a card.

states.name: Animated
states.note: A shimmer runs over the placeholder — but only when the user has not asked for reduced motion.

parts.name: Content
parts.note: The real content, which takes the placeholder's place once there is nothing left to load.

props.name: variant
props.description: Which placeholder shape to draw, under the name Element Plus gives it. It falls back to the shape prop when it is left out.
props.descriptionZh: 画哪一种占位形状,用的是 Element Plus 的叫法。不传的时候用形状属性。

props.name: animated
props.description: Shimmers the placeholder while the content loads. The animation is wrapped in a prefers-reduced-motion query, so a user who asked for less motion gets a still placeholder.
props.descriptionZh: 内容加载时让占位块闪动。动画包在 prefers-reduced-motion 查询里,所以要求减弱动效的用户看到的是静止的占位块。

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows the placeholder. Turn it off and the default slot — the real content — takes its place.
props.descriptionZh: 显示占位块。关掉之后,默认插槽里的真实内容顶上它的位置。

props.name: width
props.description: How wide the placeholder is, as a percentage of its container. A line of text usually wants a width under 100.
props.descriptionZh: 占位块占容器的宽度百分比。一行文字通常不满宽。

slots.name: default
slots.description: The real content. It takes the placeholder's place while nothing is loading.
slots.descriptionZh: 真实内容。没有东西在加载的时候,它顶上占位块的位置。

a11y.notes: A skeleton is a placeholder, not content: mark it aria-hidden so a screen reader does not read a row of empty boxes, and put aria-busy="true" on the region that is loading. The real content replaces it when it arrives — nothing else is needed.
a11y.notesZh: 骨架屏是占位,不是内容:给它加上 aria-hidden,免得读屏念出一排空盒子;正在加载的那块区域写上 aria-busy="true"。真正的内容到了就把它换掉,别的就不需要了。

examples.title: Shapes
examples.description: One shape per kind of placeholder. The width is set inline because it is a measurement, not a shape.
examples.descriptionZh: 一种占位对应一种形状。宽度用内联样式给,因为它是尺寸,不是形状。

examples.title: Animated
examples.description: The shimmer is a background gradient moving across the placeholder. It is inside a prefers-reduced-motion query, so the library never overrides a user who has asked for less motion — the placeholder simply stays still.
examples.descriptionZh: 微光是一层横向移动的背景渐变。它包在 prefers-reduced-motion 查询里,所以库永远不会盖过要求减弱动效的用户 —— 占位块就安静地停在那里。

notes: The shimmer is a gradient on a background that is four times wider than the placeholder, moved by one keyframe from one end to the other. The whole rule sits inside prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference, which is the library's way of saying that motion is a thing the user can turn off.
notesZh: 微光是一层比占位块宽四倍的背景渐变,靠一个关键帧从一端移到另一端。整条规则都写在 prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference 里面 —— 这是库在说:动效这件事,用户可以关掉。
